description: Search the 152 free tools of Private AI Tools (PDF, image, video, audio, developer, data, calculators…) by task, e.g. "compress pdf", "remove background" or "json to yaml". Returns up to 8 tools, best first, with their page URL; when no tool matches well, the closest ones with partial: true. The tools run in the user's web browser: give the user the link. Files are never sent to this server or to the assistant.

language.description: Language of the names, descriptions and pages: en, it, es, fr, de. Default: the language the query is written in, else en. Use the user's language.

query.description: What the user wants to do, in a few words, e.g. "merge pdf" or "unire pdf"

name: find_tools
title: Find a free browser tool
